This new page wraps its content in a `ScreenWrapper` and lays it out in plain `View`s (via `SearchNLFilterContent`) without a `ScrollView`. It is not a virtualized-list screen, and the natural-language input uses `autoGrowHeight`, so on small screens (or with a tall input plus the on-screen keyboard) the content can exceed the viewport and get clipped. Wrap the growable content in a `ScrollView` so the page stays usable as it grows.

If this RHP fragment is intentionally fixed-height and must not scroll, this can be disregarded.
